summary: These changes improve media playback and audio timing: track resets and seeks are handled more selectively, unknown live-stream durations stay open until downloading ends, and audio-related promises are resolved on the media graph thread. Video conversion is also made more consistent across I420 and NV12 formats, with support for color ranges, color matrices, and rotation. The web platform’s Feature Policy APIs and files were renamed to Permissions Policy, the standard name for rules that let sites control access to browser features.
